newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * Foreign Minister Teodor Melescanu to attend U.N. general assembly in New York and sign on Tuesday nuclear tests ban treaty.
* President Ion Iliescu will write to presidents of NATO-member states to reiterate Romania's commitment to join the alliance, Melescanu said.
* Romania has reached the stage of capital market creation, Reform Minister Mircea Cosea told a news conference. He said the process will speed up reform and attract foreign investors.
* Trading on electronic over-the-counter market could start at the end of next week, businessman George Paunescu said.
* Some 7.5 million shareholder certificates have been mailed to their owners, state secretary Hildegard Puwak said.
* Cabinet suggested a five percent wage rise as fourth quarter indexation following June price hikes for fuel, electrivity and thermal power.

* National Peasant Party's secretary general Radu Vasile slammed the government for subsidising the mining sector, saying subsidies pay only wages and are not used for investments and restructuring. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
